description: Implementation of StaticContentFileManager that manages static content files such as adding, removing, and retrieving files within a content management system.

classes.name: StaticContentFileManagerImpl
classes.description: A class responsible for managing static content files such as adding, removing, and retrieving files, extending StaticContentFileManager.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a static content file for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file based on merchant store code, content type, and filename.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file based on merchant store code, content type, and content name.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of filenames for a specified merchant store and content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a merchant store.
